name_zh: 柬埔寨·波尔布特：农业乌托邦与阶级清洗自毁
name_en: Cambodia Pol Pot: Agrarian Utopia & Class Purge Self-Destruction
description_zh: 波尔布特 (1925-1998) 红色高棉领袖，1975-1979年零年政策清空城市废除货币市场学校家庭，170万人死于饥荒处决，1979越军推翻，留下人类历史最惨烈自毁实验。
description_en: Pol Pot (1925-1998) Khmer Rouge leader, 1975-1979 Year Zero policy emptied cities abolished money markets schools family, 1.7M died starvation execution, 1979 Vietnamese invasion overthrew, left human history most horrific self-destruction experiment.
reason_zh: 波尔布特代表意识形态狂热如何将乌托邦幻觉转化为毁灭性现实，展示了阶级清洗逻辑如何在封闭体系中自我放大至民族灭绝边缘，成为人类警世教材。
reason_en: Pol Pot represents how ideological fanaticism transforms utopian illusion into destructive reality, demonstrating how class purge logic self-amplifies to ethnic extinction brink in closed system, becoming human cautionary textbook.
steps_zh: 研究波尔布特早年巴黎留学马列激进化
分析1975零年政策城市清空与集体农场建立
探讨吐斯廉监狱S-21精英清洗与全国阶级灭绝
评估1979越军入侵与红色高棉丛林游击延续
总结农业乌托邦阶级清洗自毁对人类文明的永恒警示
steps_en: Study Pol Pot early Paris studies Marxist radicalization
Analyze 1975 Year Zero policy city evacuation and collective farms
Explore Tuol Sleng S-21 elite purge and nationwide class extermination
Evaluate 1979 Vietnamese invasion and Khmer Rouge jungle guerrilla continuation
Summarize agrarian utopia class purge self-destruction eternal warning for human civilization
expected_zh: 理解乌托邦工程如何必然导向反人类罪行，掌握封闭体制中意识形态自我放大毁灭机制，评估波尔布特遗产对后极权主义理论的核心反面教材价值。
expected_en: Understand how utopian engineering inevitably leads to crimes against humanity, grasp closed system ideological self-amplification destruction mechanism, evaluate Pol Pot legacy core negative textbook value for post-totalitarian theory.
case_zh: 1925 出生；1975 零年；1979 倒台；1998 逝世。农业乌托邦阶级清洗自毁范式永存。
case_en: 1925 birth; 1975 Year Zero; 1979 fall; 1998 death. Agrarian utopia class purge self-destruction paradigm endures.
intellectual_tradition: Khmer Rouge Radical Marxism / Agrarian Utopianism
cross_cultural_impact: Genocide warning; radical utopianism; ideological fanaticism; Year Zero concept
